scope.transport: 100 concurrent client HTTP requests to an ephemeral loopback-only harness around the actual platform-assets service
scope.database: isolated temporary SQLite with all actual social migrations; deleted after execution
scope.identity: synthetic account/session fixture inserted directly; this does not verify production login or sessions
scope.strongAuthorization: single-use action/account-bound in-memory authorization fixture; no actual WebAuthn was exercised
scope.concurrency: Promise.all client requests with serialized synchronous SQLite transactions in one Node service process; not 100 real devices or parallel SQL worker threads
scope.funds: SIM-USD and SIM-FUN only; no real funds, network chain or wallet keys
limitations: The minimal HTTP harness does not exercise frontend routing, CSRF, production authentication, WebAuthn or UI.
Latency includes the local client and SQLite FULL synchronous writes; it is not a production capacity promise.
Receipt fields are verified against authoritative persisted claim rows and double-entry journals using BigInt.

非成员、退群、重入和晚入禁止领取；未领取份额到期只退一次

余额不足、凭据错误与资金保护不能部分扣款或创建红包
重复投递只产生每个红包一条权威群消息
